title: dotnet-crap JSON report v1
description: Output of 'dotnet-crap --format json'. Consumers must ignore unknown fields: minor releases may add fields, but never remove, rename or retype one.

threshold.description: Score threshold used for the policy; equality passes.

skipped_files.description: Selected sources skipped because they did not parse (--skip-unparsed). Absent when none were skipped.

message.description: Syntax error message that would have failed the scan.

partial_files.description: Selected sources that did not parse, of which only the intact callables were scored (--partial-unparsed). Absent when none.

message.description: Syntax error message that would have failed the scan.

unscored.description: Callables found in the file but not scored because their syntax, or that of an enclosing callable, has an error.

coverage_complete.description: Whether every callable has coverage evidence.

name.description: Display name derived from the callable syntax.

coverage.description: Fraction of supplied coverage points hit; null without coverage evidence. Always present.

scope.description: Enclosing namespaces, types and callables, joined with '.'.

signature.description: Name plus parameter types, such as Parse(string,int).

baseline.description: Baseline outcome of a failing callable. Absent without a baseline and for passing callables.
Baseline comparison counts. Absent unless a baseline was used.
